lessons.title: A second voice
body: This synth has three oscillators - three voices singing the same note. The mixer decides how loud each one sings.
Oscillator 2 is parked slightly out of tune. Bring its level up until you hear the sound thicken and shimmer, like two singers almost in unison.

goal.hint: Blend in the second voice until the sound thickens - present, but not louder than the first.

lessons.title: Fatten it up
body: Detune slides one oscillator a few cents off the other. A few cents: a slow, warm beating. Too many: out of tune.
This is the classic 'fat' sound. Listen for the gentle wobble - slow and warm, not seasick.

goal.hint: Find the slow, warm wobble - fat, not sour.

lessons.title: Go low
body: Oscillator 3 can drop one or two octaves below the others. That is where bass comes from.
Its level is already up - your job is the octave switch. Take it down until the sound grows a chest.

goal.hint: Drop the third voice until the sound grows a chest - one floor down, not two.
